WITH scoped AS (
  SELECT r.*
  FROM reservables r
  WHERE r.deleted_at IS NULL
    AND (${vendor:sqlstring} IN ('', '__all') OR r.vendor IN (${vendor:sqlstring}))
    AND (${source:sqlstring} IN ('', '__all') OR r.source IN (${source:sqlstring}))
    AND (${site_type:sqlstring} IN ('', '__all') OR r.site_type IN (${site_type:sqlstring}))
)
SELECT count(*) AS active_reservables FROM scoped;

WITH scoped AS (

WITH scoped AS (
  SELECT r.*
  FROM reservables r
  WHERE r.deleted_at IS NULL
    AND (${vendor:sqlstring} IN ('', '__all') OR r.vendor IN (${vendor:sqlstring}))
    AND (${source:sqlstring} IN ('', '__all') OR r.source IN (${source:sqlstring}))

)

WITH scoped AS (
  SELECT r.*
  FROM reservables r
  WHERE r.deleted_at IS NULL
    AND (${vendor:sqlstring} IN ('', '__all') OR r.vendor IN (${vendor:sqlstring}))
    AND (${source:sqlstring} IN ('', '__all') OR r.source IN (${source:sqlstring}))
    AND (${site_type:sqlstring} IN ('', '__all') OR r.site_type IN (${site_type:sqlstring}))
)
SELECT
  p.id AS poi_id,
  p.name,
  p.category,
  p.source,
  p.region,
  count(DISTINCT r.id) AS reservable_count,
  max(s.observed_at) AS latest_observed_at,
  ST_X(ST_Centroid(p.geom)) AS lng,
  ST_Y(ST_Centroid(p.geom)) AS lat
FROM scoped r
JOIN reservable_pois rp ON rp.reservable_id = r.id
JOIN pois p ON p.id = rp.poi_id
LEFT JOIN availability_snapshot s ON s.reservable_id = r.id
WHERE p.deleted_at IS NULL
GROUP BY p.id
ORDER BY reservable_count DESC, p.name ASC
LIMIT 2000;

WITH scoped AS (
  SELECT r.*
  FROM reservables r
  WHERE r.deleted_at IS NULL
    AND (${vendor:sqlstring} IN ('', '__all') OR r.vendor IN (${vendor:sqlstring}))
    AND (${source:sqlstring} IN ('', '__all') OR r.source IN (${source:sqlstring}))
    AND (${site_type:sqlstring} IN ('', '__all') OR r.site_type IN (${site_type:sqlstring}))
)
SELECT
  vendor,
  type,
  coalesce(site_type, '(none)') AS site_type,
  count(*) AS reservables,
  count(*) FILTER (WHERE raw IS NOT NULL) AS with_raw,
  count(*) FILTER (WHERE tags IS NOT NULL) AS with_tags,
  count(*) FILTER (WHERE provider_ref IS NOT NULL) AS with_provider_ref,
  max(updated_at) AS latest_updated_at,
  now() - max(updated_at) AS latest_update_age
FROM scoped
GROUP BY 1, 2, 3
ORDER BY reservables DESC;

WITH scoped AS (
  SELECT r.*
  FROM reservables r
  WHERE r.deleted_at IS NULL
    AND (${vendor:sqlstring} IN ('', '__all') OR r.vendor IN (${vendor:sqlstring}))
    AND (${source:sqlstring} IN ('', '__all') OR r.source IN (${source:sqlstring}))
    AND (${site_type:sqlstring} IN ('', '__all') OR r.site_type IN (${site_type:sqlstring}))
)
SELECT
  r.vendor,
  r.type,
  count(DISTINCT r.id) AS reservables,
  count(DISTINCT s.reservable_id) AS reservables_with_observations,
  count(s.id) FILTER (WHERE s.observed_at >= now() - (${days_back:sqlstring} || ' days')::interval) AS snapshots_in_window,
  max(s.observed_at) AS latest_observed_at,
  now() - max(s.observed_at) AS latest_observation_age
FROM scoped r
LEFT JOIN availability_snapshot s ON s.reservable_id = r.id
GROUP BY r.vendor, r.type
ORDER BY reservables DESC;

WITH scoped AS (
  SELECT r.*
  FROM reservables r
  WHERE r.deleted_at IS NULL
    AND (${vendor:sqlstring} IN ('', '__all') OR r.vendor IN (${vendor:sqlstring}))
    AND (${source:sqlstring} IN ('', '__all') OR r.source IN (${source:sqlstring}))
    AND (${site_type:sqlstring} IN ('', '__all') OR r.site_type IN (${site_type:sqlstring}))
)
SELECT
  s.status::text AS status,
  s.available,
  count(*) AS snapshots,
  min(s.observed_at) AS first_observed_at,
  max(s.observed_at) AS latest_observed_at
FROM scoped r
JOIN availability_snapshot s ON s.reservable_id = r.id
WHERE s.observed_at >= now() - (${days_back:sqlstring} || ' days')::interval
GROUP BY s.status, s.available
ORDER BY snapshots DESC;

WITH scoped AS (
  SELECT r.*
  FROM reservables r
  WHERE r.deleted_at IS NULL
    AND (${vendor:sqlstring} IN ('', '__all') OR r.vendor IN (${vendor:sqlstring}))
    AND (${source:sqlstring} IN ('', '__all') OR r.source IN (${source:sqlstring}))
    AND (${site_type:sqlstring} IN ('', '__all') OR r.site_type IN (${site_type:sqlstring}))
)
SELECT
  p.id AS poi_id,
  p.name,
  p.category,
  p.source,
  p.region,
  count(DISTINCT r.id) AS reservable_count,
  count(DISTINCT s.reservable_id) AS reservables_with_observations,
  max(s.observed_at) AS latest_observed_at
FROM scoped r
JOIN reservable_pois rp ON rp.reservable_id = r.id
JOIN pois p ON p.id = rp.poi_id
LEFT JOIN availability_snapshot s ON s.reservable_id = r.id
WHERE p.deleted_at IS NULL
GROUP BY p.id
ORDER BY reservable_count DESC, p.name ASC
LIMIT 200;

SELECT
  'active_unlinked_reservables' AS metric,
  count(*) AS rows
FROM reservables r
WHERE r.deleted_at IS NULL
  AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM reservable_pois rp WHERE rp.reservable_id = r.id)
UNION ALL
SELECT
  'deleted_reservables' AS metric,
  count(*) AS rows
FROM reservables r
WHERE r.deleted_at IS NOT NULL
UNION ALL
SELECT
  'links_to_deleted_pois' AS metric,
  count(*) AS rows
FROM reservable_pois rp
JOIN pois p ON p.id = rp.poi_id
WHERE p.deleted_at IS NOT NULL
UNION ALL
SELECT
  'links_to_deleted_reservables' AS metric,
  count(*) AS rows
FROM reservable_pois rp
JOIN reservables r ON r.id = rp.reservable_id
WHERE r.deleted_at IS NOT NULL;
